{{Top}}
[[File:Concussionblaster.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Fett's concussion grenade launcher]]
'''Concussion grenade launchers''' were a type of weapon that launched [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenades]]. The [[IG-series/Legends|IG assassin droid]] had such a launcher.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] carried a small launcher in a holster on his hip.<ref name="Boba Fett: Mystery Man in Not-So-Shining Armor">{{GalaxyCite|1|Boba Fett: Mystery Man in Not-So-Shining Armor}}</ref><ref name="SWC">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref>
